DS-0002 supabase/db/Dockerfile: The image ends without a USER, on purpose: the server starts as root. Its data directory is the volume's mount point, which a provisioner creates owned by root, and initdb as postgres (uid 100) cannot take a directory it does not own; the entrypoint gives it to postgres and drops to that uid before the server starts. Stated in deploy/k8s/README.md, Users.
KSV-0014 Deployment/gitea container/gite: Writable root filesystem, measured on gitea/gitea:28.0.0: at every start the image's setup chowns and chmods /app/gitea (the binary's directory, root's in the image) and renders /etc/ssh/sshd_config, and s6 keeps its lock and supervise directories under /etc/s6. Read-only, s6-svscan exits at once. Stated in deploy/k8s/README.md, Security contexts.
